A keyword estimate of prose register runs low against those hand-scores, so on the estimated scale the floor is implemented at 2 or below: it fires when a review explicitly names the prose as the book’s weakness, or reads it as comic-maximalist and quippy. When it fires the total is capped into Reserve regardless of how good the architecture is.
